guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Shadow Priest dungeon and raid damage on Hellscream.

mechanics.label: DoTs
mechanics.use: Maintain Vampiric Touch and Devouring Plague without clipping their final ticks.

mechanics.label: Shadow Weaving
mechanics.use: Reach five Shadow Weaving stacks before the lasting Shadow Word: Pain application.

mechanics.label: Channel
mechanics.use: Fit Mind Flay ticks between higher-priority spells and break channels deliberately.

mechanics.label: Mana & support
mechanics.use: Use Shadowfiend, Dispersion, Replenishment, and Hymn of Hope without wrecking the damage plan.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Shadow baseline
talent.summary: The complete baseline supplies every core damage and mana talent without requiring a particular party or raid composition.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with the hit target, five-stack opener, DoT rules, raid utility, and guide path.
pageDescriptions.playing: Execute the Shadow priority, preserve DoT value, channel Mind Flay cleanly, move without going idle, and recover mana.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 14/0/57 build, glyphs, macros, dot tracking, addons, and keybinds for original WotLK 3.3.5a.
pageDescriptions.building: Reach the boss spell-hit target, then compare spell power, haste, crit, spirit, gems, enchants, and professions honestly.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target practical crafted, dungeon, emblem, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum upgrades without blindly copying a final-tier BiS list.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Apply damage, Replenishment, Dispersion soaks, Mass Dispel, add control, and encounter assignments by size and difficulty.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Shadow Word: Pain snapshot details, channel timing, boss immunities, and custom encounter scripting should be verified on Hellscream when observed behavior differs.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
